bounds.note: harness bounds, not properties of the rules

properties.name: p1_ordered
properties.quote: The "DTSTART" property value always counts as the first occurrence.

properties.name: p2_count_prefix
properties.quote: The COUNT rule part defines the number of occurrences at which to range-bound the recurrence.

properties.name: p3_until_truncates
properties.quote: The UNTIL rule part defines a DATE or DATE-TIME value that bounds the recurrence rule in an inclusive manner.

properties.name: p4_setpos_subset
properties.quote: The BYSETPOS rule part specifies a COMMA-separated list of values that corresponds to the nth occurrence within the set of recurrence instances specified by the rule.

properties.name: p5_wkst_inert
properties.quote: [WKST] is significant when a WEEKLY "RRULE" has an interval greater than 1, and a BYDAY rule part is specified.  This is also significant when in a YEARLY "RRULE" when a BYWEEKNO rule part is specified.

properties.name: p6_limit_superset
properties.quote: BYxxx rule parts for a period of time that is the same or greater than the frequency generally reduce or limit the number of occurrences of the recurrence generated.

properties.name: p7_interval_subset
properties.quote: The INTERVAL rule part contains a positive integer representing at which intervals the recurrence rule repeats.

properties.name: p8_duplicate_value_inert
properties.quote: When duplicate instances are generated by the "RRULE" and "RDATE" properties, only one recurrence is considered.  Duplicate instances are ignored.
